stem.text: Ethanal and hydrogen cyanide react together to form a compound used in the production of acrylic fibres. The reaction mechanism involves cyanide ions.

stem.alt: Mechanism: cyanide ion (CN with negative charge) attacks the C=O carbon of ethanal with curly arrows, the O negative intermediate takes an H from HCN, giving CH3CH(OH)CN and regenerating :CN with negative charge.

stem.text: Which statements about this mechanism are correct?
